title.zh: PrismML把90亿参数模型权重压到2GB：iPhone本地每秒生成34个Token
title.en: PrismML把90亿参数模型权重压到2GB：iPhone本地每秒生成34个Token

current_state.zh: PrismML released Bonsai 2 (2B/4B/9B) models derived from Qwen3.5 with ternary weights that compress the 9B model to 2GB, enabling ~34 tokens/sec local generation on iPhone under Apache 2.0, with benchmark gaps versus the full-precision original on complex tasks.
